nodes.name: Impregnation synthesis of Ni/TiO2
nodes.procedure: TiO2 (anatase, 3.00 g) was dispersed in a Ni(NO3)2·6H2O solution (2.22 g, 5.0 mL). The slurry was stirred at room temperature for 3 h, aged for 24 h, and then dried at 60°C for 12 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows Ni particle sizes: 11.8, 12.5, 11.7, 13.8 nm for 400-600°C samples; Ni nanoparticles well-dispersed in TiO2-x matrix.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In addition, the particle size of Ni (Figure 2A1-D1) increases slightly from ~11.7 to ~13.8 nm as the reduction temperature rises from 400 to 600°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM lattice fringes: 0.203 nm (Ni {111}), 0.350 nm (TiO2 {101}); TiO2-x particles (5-7 nm) anchor on Ni nanoparticle surfaces.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM images (Figure 2A2-D2) show the TiO2-x phase (particle size: 5-7 nm) anchoring on the surface of single Ni nanoparticle: the lattice fringe of 0.203 nm corresponds to the {111} plane of cubic Ni phase; while that of 0.350 nm is indexed to the {101} plane of rhombic TiO2 phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM-EDS shows disordered Ti:O distribution (1:2 molar ratio) on Ni surface and Gaussian elemental mapping confirming TiO2 overlayer modification.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The STEM-EDS line scan spectrum of one individual Ni nanoparticle shows a disordered distribution of Ti and O on the surface of Ni with a molar ratio of ~1:2.

nodes.characterization_summary: CO chemisorption shows coverage degree increasing from 66% (400°C) to 92% (600°C); Ni dispersion lower than TEM-estimated values confirming TiO2-x decoration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The coverage degree of Ni nanoparticle is determined by CO chemiadsorption over these four Ni@TiO2-x samples (Table 1), which shows an increase from 66% to 92% with the enhancement of reduction temperature from 400 to 600°C.

nodes.characterization_summary: H2-TPR of NiTi-MMO shows weakened bulk NiO peak (~290°C), dominant dispersed NiO peak (~405°C), and TiO2 reduction shoulder (500-630°C); total H2 consumption 11.2 mmol gcat⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the amount of H2 consumption for NiTi-MMO and NiO-TiO2 is calculated to be 11.2 mmol gcat⁻¹ and 3.15 mmol gcat⁻¹, respectively.
